insights.summary: The agent performed a high-quality optimization of the vLLM logits processing logic. It successfully identified that the MinP implementation was inefficiently converting to probabilities just to perform a threshold check, and refactored it to work in logit-space. It also adhered to all prompt constraints and timing requirements.
strengths: Strong mathematical understanding of the domain (logits vs probabilities).
Very efficient use of time and tool calls.
weaknesses: Relied heavily on the prompt's suggested grep command rather than independent exploration.
Did not show explicit timing results in the final output, though it followed the script creation instructions.
